title: agrostis stolonifera var. minor
intro: Agrostis stolonifera var. minor, commonly known as creeping bentgrass, is a perennial grass species that thrives in moist environments. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis stolonifera var. minor are believed to be attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
